description: Multi-hop schema evolution migrator inadvertently overwrites explicit falsy values (0, False) with default fallbacks.
spec_notes: FieldMigrator must check key existence and None rather than boolean truthiness when applying default values.

"""Schema payload representations."""

from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional


@dataclass
class SchemaRecord:
    version: int
    data: Dict[str, Any]

tests.test_schema_migration.py:
from models import SchemaRecord
from registry import MigrationRegistry
from pipeline import SchemaEvolutionPipeline


def test_v1_to_v2_migration():
    reg = MigrationRegistry()
    pipe = SchemaEvolutionPipeline(reg)
    rec = SchemaRecord(version=1, data={"username": "alice", "first_name": "Alice", "last_name": "Smith"})
    up = pipe.upgrade(rec, 2)
    assert up.version == 2
    assert up.data["user_name"] == "alice"
    assert up.data["full_name"] == "Alice Smith"
    assert up.data["retry_count"] == 3
    assert up.data["is_active"] is True


def test_explicit_falsy_values_preserved_during_migration():
    reg = MigrationRegistry()
    pipe = SchemaEvolutionPipeline(reg)
    # Explicit 0 retry count and False is_active must NOT be overwritten by defaults 3 and True!
    rec = SchemaRecord(version=1, data={"username": "bob", "retry_count": 0, "is_active": False})
    up = pipe.upgrade(rec, 2)
    assert up.data["retry_count"] == 0
    assert up.data["is_active"] is False


def test_multi_hop_v1_to_v3_migration():
    reg = MigrationRegistry()
    pipe = SchemaEvolutionPipeline(reg)
    rec = SchemaRecord(version=1, data={"username": "carol", "first_name": "Carol", "last_name": "Danvers", "is_active": False})
    up = pipe.upgrade(rec, 3)
    assert up.version == 3
    assert up.data["user_name"] == "carol"
    assert up.data["profile"]["name"] == "Carol Danvers"
    assert up.data["profile"]["active"] is False


def test_no_op_same_version():
    reg = MigrationRegistry()
    pipe = SchemaEvolutionPipeline(reg)
    rec = SchemaRecord(version=2, data={"user_name": "dan", "full_name": "Dan"}) 
    assert pipe.upgrade(rec, 2).data == rec.data
